name: Dressing Room
source:
You are a customer of a certain cafe. 
While your coffee is being poured, you find a gamebook in a bookshelf.

Read the book and lead the protagonist to the end of the story.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE241227.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你是某家咖啡馆的顾客。咖啡倒好时，你在书架上发现一本游戏书。阅读这本书，引导主人公走到故事结尾。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE241227.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
